```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(abcdutils)

core_path <- abcdutils::path_maker(here::here("data/abcd/core"))

import <- function(path) {
    return(abcdutils::abcd_load(core_path(path)))
}

abcd_y_lt <- import("abcd-general/abcd_y_lt.csv")

mri_y_adm_info <- import("imaging/mri_y_adm_info.csv")

# Assign scanner
get_scanner_id(
    mri_y_adm_info = mri_y_adm_info,
    abcd_y_lt = abcd_y_lt,
    t = 0,
    sample_missing = TRUE
)

# Access scanner mapping data
scanner_map_t0 <- assign_site_scanner(
    mri_y_adm_info = mri_y_adm_info,
    abcd_y_lt = abcd_y_lt,
    t = 0,
    return_scanner_map = TRUE
)$"scanner_map"
scanner_map_t0

scanner_map_t2 <- assign_site_scanner(
    mri_y_adm_info = mri_y_adm_info,
    abcd_y_lt = abcd_y_lt,
    t = 2,
    return_scanner_map = TRUE
)$"scanner_map"
scanner_map_t2

scanner_map_t4 <- assign_site_scanner(
    mri_y_adm_info = mri_y_adm_info,
    abcd_y_lt = abcd_y_lt,
    t = 4,
    return_scanner_map = TRUE
)$"scanner_map"
scanner_map_t4

full_df_t0 <- data.frame()
for (site in seq_len(nrow(scanner_map_t0))) {
    scanners <- scanner_map_t0[site, ]$"scanners"
    weights <- scanner_map_t0[site, ]$"weights"
    site_id <- scanner_map_t0[site, ]$"site_id"
    for (scanner in seq_along(scanners)) {
        temp_df <- data.frame(
            site_id = site_id,
            scanner = scanners[[scanner]],
            weight = weights[[scanner]],
            t = 0
        )
        full_df_t0 <- rbind(full_df_t0, temp_df)
        print(temp_df)
    }
}
print(full_df_t0)


full_df_t2 <- data.frame()
for (site in seq_len(nrow(scanner_map_t2))) {
    scanners <- scanner_map_t0[site, ]$"scanners"
    weights <- scanner_map_t0[site, ]$"weights"
    site_id <- scanner_map_t0[site, ]$"site_id"
    for (scanner in seq_along(scanners)) {
        temp_df <- data.frame(
            site_id = site_id,
            scanner = scanners[[scanner]],
            weight = weights[[scanner]],
            t = 2
        )
        full_df <- rbind(full_df, temp_df)
        print(temp_df)
    }
}
print(full_df_t2)

full_df_t4 <- data.frame()
for (site in seq_len(nrow(scanner_map_t4))) {
    scanners <- scanner_map_t0[site, ]$"scanners"
    weights <- scanner_map_t0[site, ]$"weights"
    site_id <- scanner_map_t0[site, ]$"site_id"
    for (scanner in seq_along(scanners)) {
        temp_df <- data.frame(
            site_id = site_id,
            scanner = scanners[[scanner]],
            weight = weights[[scanner]],
            t = 4
        )
        full_df <- rbind(full_df, temp_df)
        print(temp_df)
    }
}
print(full_df_t4)

full_df_t0

df <- dplyr::bind_rows(full_df_t0)

df

df$"site_id" <- factor(df$"site_id")

plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = site_id, y = weight, fill = scanner)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  labs(x = "Site", y = "Proportion of scans") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) 
plot

ggsave(
    "scanner_distribution_t0.png",
    plot = plot,
    width = 10,
    height = 6
)
```
